name: Cover Art Archive
summary: Free cover art for MusicBrainz releases and release groups: JSON image listings and direct image redirects in several sizes.
description: Community-curated album artwork keyed by MusicBrainz release or release-group IDs. A listing endpoint returns every image with type flags (front, back, booklet), comments and thumbnail URLs; front and back shortcuts and sized thumbnails (250, 500, 1200 px) redirect to the image files hosted on the Internet Archive.

rate_limit.summary: No numeric limit documented; the docs list HTTP 503 for clients that exceed their rate limit.

endpoints.summary: JSON listing of all artwork for a release (redirects to an Internet Archive index.json)
Redirect to the front cover image; also /back and /{image-id}
Redirect to a 250, 500 or 1200 px thumbnail
JSON listing of artwork for a release group, taken from one of its releases

license.name: Varies per image; uploaded by MusicBrainz users

agent_notes: Get MusicBrainz release or release-group MBIDs from the musicbrainz record first. The JSON endpoint answers with a 307 to archive.org (clients must follow redirects; CORS is sent on the redirect and the final response). Use /front-500 style URLs directly in img tags. A 404 means there is no art for that MBID.
caveats: Image and thumbnail URLs inside the JSON use http:// even though the service is served over https; rewrite them to https.
The listing endpoint redirects (307, then 302) to Internet Archive hosts, so responses carry several CORS headers and a slow first hit (about 1.7 s observed).
Cover images are typically copyrighted by the artwork owner; the archive does not grant reuse rights.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed with redirects followed (curl -L), as bin/verify.php does.
